4. **Free boulder #1.** The trader walks back into the pocket and pushes boulder #1 east from (16,12) to (17,12).
5. **Land at (17,11).** From (21,15), the mirror at (21,11) reflects the trader to (17,11).
6. **Fill (17,16) and walk to the door.** Four south pushes drop boulder #1 into the water at (17,16). The trader then walks down column 17 to the door at (17,19).
